CREATE TABLE "v2"."V2BlobRef" (
  "hash" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("sessionId", "hash")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" WHERE ("c"."oid" = to_regclass($1) AND ("c"."relkind" = $2 OR "c"."relkind" = $3))) AS "result"

label: Backfill V2BlobRef from the $blob hashes referenced in V2Event canonical text

execute.description: Backfill V2BlobRef from V2Event canonical text
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "v2"."V2BlobRef" ("sessionId", "hash")
SELECT DISTINCT t."sessionId", (m."match")[1]
FROM "v2"."V2Event" e
JOIN "v2"."V2Thread" t ON t."id" = e."threadId"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_matches(e."canonical", '"\$blob":\{"hash":"([0-9a-f]{64})"', 'g') AS m("match")
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
